id: title:jonmcwest:track trace dialog usage from open to close

review.posthog_relevance: Adds PostHog analytics capture and session tracking to the Trace Dialog, including entry point, close reason, and interaction metrics.
review.reason: The chunk is a cohesive group of changes adding PostHog analytics and session tracking to the Trace Dialog. P1.F5.H11 adds an entry point and metadata. P1.F6.H4, P1.F6.H6, and P1.F6.H7 implement the capture and session tracking, recording dialog open/close, entry point, and interaction metrics. This establishes a mechanism for PostHog to record user behavior and funnel conversion,
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the implementation of a bounded capability (adding analytics capture). The actual benefit, such as improved conversion tracking or user behavior insights, is not demonstrated by the code and cannot be inferred. No production incident or adoption is established.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by test and implementation changes. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds an entry point and opened-from metadata to the trace dialog, and records the dialog's close reason.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows distinguishing the origin of a trace inspection, potentially supporting future analytics or debugging. No score assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds PostHog analytics capture and session tracking to the Trace Dialog, including entry point, close reason, and interaction metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: Records dialog open/close and load events with entry point and reason, enabling PostHog to track user behavior and funnel conversion in the Tracing product.

observations.behavior: Records dialog open and close events with entry point and reason, and tracks load success, failure, and interaction metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: Stores session state and captures open event; this establishes the mechanism for PostHog to record the start of a tracing session.

observations.behavior: Records dialog close event with reason and clears session, and records load and interaction metrics.
observations.posthog_connection: Records close event and clears session; this establishes the mechanism for PostHog to record the end of a tracing session.
